title: BC26 Noisy-Student SED student (effv2s, soundscape-adapted)
subtitle: tf_efficientnetv2_s.in21k 234-head trained on distilled-SED pseudo-labeled train_soundscapes (Nikita noisy-student); diversity member vs the b0 student
description:
Noisy-student SED student for BirdCLEF+ 2026, EfficientNetV2-S (in21k) backbone. A DIVERSITY member alongside the tf_efficientnet_b0 sibling: same Nikita recipe, larger fused-MBConv / in21k-pretrained backbone => orthogonal feature space on the SOUNDSCAPE test domain.

Domain-adapts a 1ch log-mel CNN from FOCAL train_audio to the SOUNDSCAPE test domain (the fix for the FOCAL-only effv2s that HURT the blend).

TEACHER: distilled-SED ONNX ensemble (tuckerarrants/bc2026-distilled-sed-public, 5 folds) on the unlabeled train_soundscapes. (Public Perch v2 ONNX exposes only a generic 14,795-class head, not the 234-class space, so it is omitted.)

RECIPE (Nikita Babych 2025 #1): pure power-transform soft pseudo-labels (threshold=0, per-round power 1.0/1.54/1.82/1.67), MANDATORY fixed-lambda=0.5 MixUp of every sample with a random pseudo soundscape sample, soft cross-entropy, AdamW lr 5e-4 cosine, AMP, channels_last. Multi-round: the student re-labels the soundscapes and becomes the next teacher.

FILES:
  - ns_student_tf_efficientnetv2_s_in21k_fold1_fp16.pt : state_dict (fp16) + classes(234) + config.
  - ns_student_soundscape_preds.parquet : student soft preds on all soundscape windows (orthogonality/quality check vs the b0 student and the 0.950 base).

Blend onto the proven 0.950 EoS9 base by rank-blend.
